title: Updating the outer vertex
statement: For any counting-algorithm state $\sigma$ and natural number $z$, replacing coordinate $10$ of the register vector of $\sigma$ by $z$ gives the register vector of the state obtained by replacing its outer-vertex register $v$ by $z$.
replaced:
Let a state consist of seventeen natural-number registers, including an outer-vertex
register, and let its register vector list these coordinates in order, with the
outer-vertex register in coordinate $10$. For any state and any natural number $z$,
replacing coordinate $10$ of its register vector by $z$ gives the register vector of the
state obtained by setting its outer-vertex register to $z$.
